en: The front of the postcard features an old black-and-white photograph of a city square with well-kept residential or hotel buildings and a small monument in the landscaped area of the square. The street is lined with trees and streetcar rails can be seen. Handwritten script overlays the image, along with printed text identifying the location as 'Allenauplatz, Pyrmont.' The back shows a German stamp, a dated postmark from 'Pyrmont', more handwritten German text, and an address to 'Elsa Bracksieck, Villa Seeluft, Wangerooge.' There is also a museum stamp: 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
